summary.conclusion: CLEAR exposes a similarity over 368,294 free-text observations, not a curated finding vocabulary. No preregistered concept is a single model output. Every concept would have to be constructed by aggregating over many matching sentences, a large share of which are NEGATED assertions of the same finding. That aggregation rule is a modelling choice this project has not preregistered, it is not specified by CLEAR's documentation, and choosing it after seeing associations would be exactly the post-hoc selection the protocol forbids.
